findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Environment variable or command line argument access
 * @description Accessing environment variables or command line arguments can be a source of untrusted input.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity medium
 * @id py/env-access
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-020
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::Node node
where
  node = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("environ").getAValueReachableFromSource() or
  node = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("getenv").getACall() or
  node = API::moduleImport("sys").getMember("argv").getAValueReachableFromSource()
select node, "Access to environment variable or command line argument."
findings.hypothesis: Usage of environment variables or command line arguments might introduce untrusted input.
